project: Alpha Desk V1 — Quantitative Trading Research, Validation & Risk Platform
phases_planned: Phase 1: data backbone (prices, macro, fundamentals) -- DONE
Phase 2: validation engine (purged walk-forward CV, deflated Sharpe, PBO, transaction-cost model) -- DONE
Phase 3: statistical arbitrage / pairs trading module -- DONE
Phase 4: cross-sectional equity factor long/short module -- DONE

Phase 5: ML return classifier (gradient-boosted, calibrated) -- DONE (re-numbered ahead of the originally-planned time-series momentum module per user request for genuine ML, not just deterministic/econometric methods)
Phase 6: time-series momentum module (ETF proxies) -- DONE
Phase 8: risk & execution control tower (VaR/CVaR, stress tests, Almgren-Chriss) -- DONE
Phase 9: limit order book microstructure / market-making simulator (Avellaneda-Stoikov) -- DONE (disclosed: real volatility calibration, simulated order flow -- see docs/MICROSTRUCTURE_STRATEGY.md)

Phase 10: VIX term-structure / vol relative-value module -- DONE (real VIX/VIX3M/SVXY/VIXY data; harvest side net Sharpe 0.79/PSR 0.998, hedge side does not hold up -- see docs/VOL_RELVAL_STRATEGY.md)

Phase 11: Alpaca paper-trading execution -- DONE (thin tested REST client, 13 tests against mocked HTTP; live-verified against a real Alpaca paper account the user created -- see docs/ALPACA_EXECUTION.md)

platform_layer.backend: service/ -- FastAPI, thin read layer over pre-computed artifacts/*.json (not a live-recompute API; see service/artifacts_io.py)
platform_layer.frontend: frontend/ -- Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + Recharts, dark-first trading-desk UI, one page per strategy phase plus an overview dashboard
platform_layer.status: DONE for phases 1-11's reporting surface -- all 11 planned phases have a router + page

data_sources.prices: Yahoo Finance (yfinance) -- real, unofficial endpoint, not a licensed vendor
data_sources.macro: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis) -- government-authoritative, though one series (BAMLH0A0HYM2) only has ~3 years of history via this endpoint -- see docs/DATA_BACKBONE.md
data_sources.fundamentals: SEC EDGAR XBRL company-facts API -- government-authoritative
